not_found: Dineout order-page prices (not fetched; may differ from the PDF). Whether the summer menu is still being served in late October. The menu says all pizzas can be made gluten-free or with vegan mozzarella, with no price given. There is a lunch offer Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 where all pizzas or salads cost 2899 with coffee included; I did not record it as a menu price.
diff_vs_current: prices went up from the mock 2899 (all eight items) to 2999–4199. Not in the current menu: "Super Piccante" (ol-7). Added: Vegana, Piccante, Margherita Speciale, Estiva, Vegetariana, Fiducia, Juventino, Milanista, Interista, Carnivora, Tirolese, plus the kids pizza. Mock descriptions are English only; the menu has both languages. The mock "Cotto" ingredients match, apart from burrata being listed before Parmigiano.
